items.exampleEn: The general opinion is that the plan is too expensive.
items.exampleZh: 大家普遍的看法是這個計畫太貴了。

items.exampleEn: The hotel has high standards of service.
items.exampleZh: 這家飯店的服務標準很高。

items.exampleEn: What sort of music do you like?
The shop sells various kinds of tea.
items.exampleZh: 這家店賣各種各樣的茶。

items.exampleEn: The main entrance is on the left.
Don't put the cup so close to the edge of the table.
items.exampleZh: 別把杯子放在那麼靠近桌子邊緣的地方。

items.exampleEn: Oil floats on the surface of water.
The floor has a pattern of black and white squares.
items.exampleZh: 地板上有黑白方格的圖案。

items.sentenceEn: The main reason I moved here is the good schools.
items.sentenceZh: 我搬來這裡的主要原因是學校很好。

items.audioEn: This sort of phone is popular with students because it's cheap.
items.audioZh: 這種手機很受學生歡迎，因為很便宜。
items.questionZh: 這種手機為什麼受學生歡迎？

items.sentenceEn: The surface of the lake was as smooth as glass.
items.sentenceZh: 湖面平靜得像玻璃一樣。

items.sentenceEn: Our food must meet high safety standards.
items.sentenceZh: 我們的食品必須符合很高的安全標準。

items.stemEn: The museum shows art from ____ countries around the world.
items.stemZh: 這間博物館展出來自世界各國的藝術品。

items.stemEn: The cat is sleeping on the ____ of the bed, and it might fall off.
items.stemZh: 貓睡在床邊上，可能會掉下去。

items.passageEn: Mrs. Lin makes cloth bags by hand. In general, her bags look simple, but each one has a different pattern. She uses various colors and sorts of cloth. The main reason people love her bags is the high standard of her work: the surface of every bag is smooth, and the edges are cut carefully. She sells them at a weekend market, and they are usually gone by noon.
items.passageZh: 林太太用手工做布包。一般來說，她的包包看起來很簡單，但每一個的圖案都不一樣。她用各種顏色和種類的布。大家喜愛她的包包，主要原因是她做工的水準很高：每個包包的表面都很平滑，邊緣也剪得很仔細。她在週末市集賣這些包包，通常不到中午就賣完了。

questions.questionZh: 大家喜愛林太太包包的主要原因是什麼？
關於林太太的包包，下列何者正確？
options: 每個包包的圖案都不一樣
每個包包都是用機器做的

items.promptZh: 一般來說，這裡冬天不太冷。
referenceEn: In general, it is not very cold here in winter.
In general, winters here are not too cold.
rubricZh: in general 表示「一般來說」，常放句首
說的是一般情況，多用現在簡單式
「不太冷」可寫 not very cold、not too cold 等

items.promptZh: 他換了新工作之後，睡覺的模式就變了。
referenceEn: His sleep pattern changed after he got a new job.
After he started his new job, his sleeping pattern changed.
rubricZh: 用 pattern 表示「模式」（例如 sleep pattern、sleeping pattern 等）
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 changed、has changed since… 等）
